cards.card_text: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates River all the way to the Wadi of Egypt.
cards.verse_text: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, O Israelites, will be gathered one by one.

cards.card_text: Isaiah says caraway is not threshed with a sledge, and a cart wheel is not rolled over the cumin.
cards.verse_text: Surely caraway is not threshed with a sledge, and the wheel of a cart is not rolled over the cumin.
cards.snippet: Surely caraway is not threshed with a sledge, and the wheel of a cart is not rolled…

cards.card_text: It will be new and sharp, with many teeth, and Israel will thresh the mountains and reduce the hills to chaff.
cards.verse_text: You will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.
cards.snippet: You will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.

cards.card_text: New picture: Ephraim is a well-trained heifer that loves to thresh.
cards.verse_text: Ephraim is a well-trained heifer that loves to thresh; but I will place a yoke on her fair neck.
cards.snippet: Ephraim is a well-trained heifer that loves to thresh; but I will place a yoke on her fair neck.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD speaks, and He starts with Damascus, the head of Aram (Isaiah 7:8): "For three transgressions of Damascus, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they threshed Gilead with sledges of iron."
cards.verse_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they threshed Gilead with sledges of iron.
cards.snippet: …of Damascus, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they threshed Gilead with sledges of iron.

cards.card_text: Rise and thresh Bow down to them Run to the hills
cards.verse_text: Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron and hooves of bronze to break to pieces many peoples.
cards.snippet: Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron…

cards.card_text: Habakkuk says the LORD threshed the nations in wrath.
cards.verse_text: You marched across the earth with fury; You threshed the nations in wrath.
cards.snippet: You marched across the earth with fury; You threshed the nations in wrath.
